newsitem.title: CANADA: TransCanada, others in Ukraine deals.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada, others in Ukraine deals.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd and other Canadian companies signed deals with Ukraine during an official visit to Canada by Ukrainian leaders, Canadian Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy said on Wednesday.
He said in a statement that TransCanada, based in Calgary, signed an agreement with its Ukrainian partner, Ukragazprom, to modernize Ukraine's gas transmission system. The statement gave no details.

Commercial Alcohols Inc., one of the world's top 10 producers of fermentation alcohol, signed a contract with the Ukrainian government giving it the right to develop a national program on alternative fuels to help reduce Ukraine's reliance on imported fuel.
The statement said the company was forecasting C$2 billion in fuel production by the end of 2010.

It also said Northland Power Inc received a certificate of registration from Ukraine, clearing the final administrative precondition for its C$150 million project to refurbish the Darnytsia thermal power plant near Kiev.
Axworthy also announced approval by the Ukrainian parliament of an export-financing facility valued at more than C$55 million offered by the Export Development Corp.
